brief: Explore further premium alternatives from the preferred ornate Morning Gold Cafe Latte direction, retaining the stylized name and detailed coffee artwork.

directions.name: Gilded Arch
directions.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / style-transfer.
Create ONE premium packaging exploration for TRAYN Radiance CAFE LATTE, portrait 2:3, one complete cylindrical food tin.
The supplied image is the preferred design reference. Preserve the EXACT recognizable TRAYN symbol and TRAYN NUTRITION brand lockup and the selected flowing dark coffee-brown Radiance wordmark with its generous sweeping capital R. Do not replace Radiance with standard typeset text. Keep the name prominent and highly readable, followed by DAILY PROTEIN. Keep a brushed champagne-gold metal lid and fine base rim, tactile warm ivory label, beautiful sepia engraved latte cup and saucer with visible latte art, coffee beans and a restrained coffee sprig printed at the lower right. Flavor at lower left: CAFE / LATTE, with 500 g and Contains Milk below. Keep the small notice PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE. No other copy.
This is a luxurious daily nutrition product for middle-aged and older men and women. Warm, glowing, sunshiny and full of life, with refined MATERIAL DETAIL and artisanal craftsmanship. Maintain the richness and ornamental delicacy of the preferred reference. Detailed sun and coffee elements should feel tailored and beautifully printed, with balanced readable label hierarchy.
One full tin with breathing room, a subtle three-quarter angle and warm natural studio sunlight on pale limestone. Crisp label, believable metal highlights, tactile surface and soft grounded shadow, softly blurred warm ivory background. No dramatic set, scenery painted on the label, landscape, people, props, extra packages or comparison collage. No medical, blood sugar, diabetes suitability, nutrition figure or certification claims. No chocolate.

NEW DIRECTION: GILDED ARCH. Create an elegant fine DOUBLE CHAMPAGNE-GOLD FOIL arch frame that rises gently around the upper brand and Radiance lettering, continuing into thin border rails at the label's outer sides. Keep a softly rounded architectural arch, not a religious doorway or ornate crest. Very delicate tone-on-tone coffee-leaf engraving ornaments the outer margins, as in the richness of the reference. In the lower center below DAILY PROTEIN, retain an exquisitely embossed gold sunburst, slightly smaller and carefully balanced inside the frame. The warm pale-honey lower label has an elegant curved border accented by one fine foil stroke. The full detailed latte illustration stays lower right. Ivory, pale honey, espresso ink and restrained gold. Sophisticated, luminous and highly crafted, like a premium artisanal food tin to keep on the kitchen counter. Do not make the frame thick or crowded.

Lower third is a beautifully sophisticated satin caramel-cafe-creme color field with a narrow deep-coffee-brown base band and precise champagne-gold rules. The lower field is a LABEL COLOR, not a photographed liquid. Retain a small embossed sunburst in soft brushed gold between DAILY PROTEIN and the lower flavor field. Subtle pearl and champagne light gives the label a rich tactile finish. A slightly deeper brushed gold lid reinforces warmth. Elegant premium cafe ritual, warm and welcoming, no dark moody background.
